[[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]] is still alive during the events of {{InsiderCite|144|Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score}}, therefore the short story is set prior to the events of {{TCW|The Gungan General}}. {{FactFile2014|90|22 BBY 91-92|To Catch a Count}} establishes that Falso is [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the events of "The Gungan General," which it dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<noinclude>
